# Fifth precision round

Property paths: `sidebar.*`, `components.Sidebar.*`, `flows.dashboards.*`, `*.conditionalRenderingOptions`, `*.repeatOptions`, `_reusableBaseText.*`, `_reusableDynamicText.*`
File globs: `*.json`, `*.test.ts`, `*.showcase.js`
Scoped packages: `@std/*`, `@std/path`, `@grafana-plugins/<name>`
Bare alias prefixes: `@/`, `~/`, `./`, `../`
Repository scope directory: `@workspace/missing/*`, `@workspace/missing/path`
